map.第三强度理论（最大剪应力）对塑性材料，当量应力 σe=√(σ²+3τ²)，保守且: The third strength theory (maximum shear stress) for ductile materials gives the equivalent stress σe=sqrt(σ^2+3τ^2); it is conservative and widely used in engineering.
map.轴强度/刚度/疲劳计算 使用指南: How to use the shaft strength/stiffness/fatigue calculator
map.输入圆轴直径、受力与材料参数，按第四强度理论计算实心圆轴的合成应力与安全系数，评: Enter the solid shaft diameter, the loads and the material properties to compute the combined stress and safety factor with the fourth strength theory, and assess the shaft strength and fatigue reliability under combined torsion and bending.
map.键槽为何折减有效直径？: Why does a keyway reduce the effective diameter?
map.键槽产生应力集中并削弱截面，按经验取有效直径 dEff≈d−槽深影响，疲劳设计需: A keyway causes stress concentration and weakens the section; by convention the effective diameter is taken as dEff≈d minus the keyway depth effect, and fatigue design needs the stress concentration factor.
map.键槽应力集中导致有效直径折减的修正。: A correction for the effective diameter reduction caused by keyway stress concentration.
